specs: Explore Moosehead Lake and Wilson Pond with various boat types
Opportunity to see wildlife such as moose and birds while paddling
Operator must be age 21+ with valid driver's license for motorized boats
New Maine State Law: born after Jan 1, 1999 must have Maine Boater's license to operate boats over 25 HP
Renters of non-motorized watercraft must be minimum 18 years old or have a parent rent
Operator prohibited from consuming alcohol or being under the influence

blurb: Wild Ones Boat Rentals offers pontoon boats, fishing boats, canoes, kayaks, and stand-up paddleboards for exploring Moosehead Lake and Wilson Pond. Rentals include delivery options within the Moosehead Lake Region. Operators must meet age and licensing requirements depending on the boat type.
